location.venue_or_area: Indian Cove group campgrounds and amphitheatre, Joshua Tree National Park

last_edition.label: 2025 (organiser Facebook post; one local report gives 5 to 7 Dec 2025)

attendance.note: Organiser expects 'over 300 attendees' for 2026: a pre-event expectation, not a count. About 65% come from Southern California and 8 to 10% are local to the high desert.

audience.age_range: 14 and over (under 14 not permitted; 14 to 18 with a registered guardian)
audience.psychographics: Climbers from beginners to big-wall climbers and mountaineers; about 65% from Southern California; stewardship, Leave No Trace and guide-led learning focus.

ticket_price.note: 2024 registration advertised at USD 229 (Facebook group post, Google snippet). 2026 prices are on Zeffy and were not captured; beverage tickets extra.

add_sponsors.brand: Visit 29 Palms (Twentynine Palms Tourism Business Improvement District)

add_sources.note: Organiser event page for Climb Smart 2026.
Held at the Indian Cove group campgrounds and amphitheatre area inside Joshua Tree National Park under a special arrangement with the Park.
'November 20-22, 2026 @ Joshua Tree National Park'; 'Now in its 29th year'.
Organiser Facebook (Google snippet): 'Join us November 21-23 for Climb Smart 2025'. Visit 29 Palms TBID marketing update of 13 Nov 2025 also lists Nov 21 to 23.
Desert Trumpet TBID recap (Google snippet) lists 'Climb Smart (December 5-7, 2025)', which conflicts; possibly a postponement.
Google snippet of the same page: 'Friends Of Joshua Tree, a 501 c(3) non-profit organization, owns and operates the annual Climb Smart event, and has since before 2000.'
Open to all skill levels; registrants under 14 not permitted; about 65% from Southern California, 8 to 10% local.
Page links a sponsorship information document but names no sponsorship contact; info@friendsofjosh.org (Kenji or Janet) is given for volunteer enquiries and kenji@friendsofjosh.org for guides.
Google snippet: 'BUY NOW $229 won't last forever... Climb Smart 2024 is now open for registration'.
Event 'proudly sponsored by' Visit 29 Palms; page says it has 'great brand sponsors' but names none.
TBID Sponsorship and Event Grant round funded Friends of Joshua Tree, Climb Smart November 21 to 23, 2025 (Google snippet).
2024 ticket page (Google snippet): 'We always have great brand sponsors (Black Diamond, Fixe/Roca, Nomad ...'; list cut off.
Vendors and local and regional retailers on site, guide-run mini-clinics, gear giveaways, loaner gear library, evening stage shows.

notes: Small (300+) guide-led climbing and stewardship weekend run by the non-profit Friends of Joshua Tree, sponsored by the local tourism district plus outdoor brands (Black Diamond, Fixe in 2024). Has a sponsorship document linked from the event page. 'REI Climb Smart' in Los Angeles is an unrelated REI activation. No IG account identified.
